message.content:
# Murlidhar Offset Landing Page Design Specification

## 1. Color Scheme
- **Primary Background**: #0A192F (deep navy blue)
- **Secondary Background**: #112240 (slightly lighter navy)
- **Accent Color**: #F59E0B (vibrant amber/gold)
- **Text Primary**: #FFFFFF (white)
- **Text Secondary**: #CBD5E1 (light blue-gray)
- **Text Tertiary**: #64748B (medium gray)
- **Card Background**: #1E293B (dark slate)
- **Border Color**: #334155 (lighter slate)

## 2. Typography
- **Primary Font**: 'Inter' (sans-serif) - used for headings and body text
- **Secondary Font**: 'Playfair Display' (serif) - used for hero headings
- **Font Sizes**:
  - H1: 3.5rem (56px)
  - H2: 2.5rem (40px)
  - H3: 1.875rem (30px)
  - H4: 1.25rem (20px)
  - Body: 1rem (16px)
  - Small: 0.875rem (14px)
- **Font Weights**:
  - Headings: 700 (bold)
  - Body: 400 (regular)
  - Accent text: 600 (medium)

## 3. Layout Structure
- **Header**: Fixed position with navigation
- **Hero Section**: Full viewport height with centered content
- **Service Categories**: Horizontal scrolling section
- **Content Blocks**: Alternating dark/light blue background sections
- **Footer**: Multi-column layout with social links

## 4. Navigation Style
- **Logo**: Left-aligned with brand name "Murlidhar Offset" in white
- **Menu Items**: Right-aligned horizontal menu with hover effects
- **Menu Items**: "Heritage", "Services", "Finishes", "Process", "Gallery", "Contact"
- **CTA Button**: "Get a Quote" in amber with rounded corners
- **Phone Number**: Right-aligned with icon

## 5. Hero Section Design
- **Background**: Dark navy blue with subtle geometric pattern overlay
- **Main Heading**: "Where ink meets intention, and paper becomes keepsake." with "intention" and "keepsake" in amber
- **Subheading**: White text describing the company as a full-service offset printing house
- **Logo**: Circular emblem with intricate border design and brand name inside
- **CTA Buttons**: 
  - "Our Craft" in amber with rounded corners
  - "Talk on WhatsApp" with WhatsApp icon
  - "Print-Ready" in amber with star icon
- **Statistics**: 
  - "1000+" in amber
  - "FMCG Pharma" in amber
  - "Projects Delivered" and "Industry Approved" in white

## 6. Card/Grid Layouts
- **Service Cards**: Rectangular cards with rounded corners
- **Category Badges**: Small amber badges with white text
- **Service Categories**: Horizontal scrollable section with:
  - "Wedding Invitations"
  - "Mono Cartons & Packaging"
  - "Foil Stamping & Embossing"
  - "Pharmaceutical Labels"

## 7. Spacing and Visual Rhythm
- **Padding**: 4rem (64px) on all sides for main content
- **Gutter**: 2rem (32px) between grid items
- **Section Spacing**: 6rem (96px) between sections
- **Line Height**: 1.6 for body text
- **Letter Spacing**: 0.05rem for headings

## 8. Animation Styles
- **Fade-in**: Elements appear on scroll
- **Slide-in**: From bottom for hero content
- **Hover Effects**: Subtle scale on cards and buttons
- **Scroll Animation**: Smooth reveal for content blocks

## 9. Button Styles
- **Primary Button**: 
  - Background: #F59E0B (amber)
  - Text: White
  - Border-radius: 0.5rem (8px)
  - Padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem (12px 24px)
  - Font-weight: 600
- **Secondary Button**: 
  - Background: Transparent
  - Border: 1px solid #F59E0B
  - Text: #F59E0B
  - Border-radius: 0.5rem
  - Padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem

## 10. Footer Design
- **Background**: #0A192F (same as header)
- **Columns**: 4-column layout with:
  - Company info
  - Services list
  - Quick links
  - Contact information
- **Social Icons**: White icons with hover effects
- **Copyright**: Small text in #64748B

## 11. Special Visual Effects
- **Geometric Pattern**: Subtle overlay in hero section
- **Gradient**: Soft blue gradient in content blocks
- **Glass Morphism**: Subtle transparency effects on cards
- **Border Decorations**: Intricate circular border on logo
- **Shadow**: Soft shadows on cards and buttons
- **Iconography**: Custom icons for services and features

## Additional Details
- **Icons**: Custom line icons for services
- **Images**: High-quality product photography with dark borders
- **Dividers**: Subtle lines between sections
- **Loading States**: Smooth transitions for interactive elements
- **Responsive**: Fully responsive with mobile-first approach
- **Accessibility**: High contrast ratios, proper heading hierarchy

This design emphasizes elegance and professionalism with its dark color scheme, sophisticated typography, and premium feel that matches the high-end printing services offered by the company.
